title: Privacy Policy
description: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we use cookies and handle information when you access or use our website.

privacy.title: Cookies
privacy.description: We use cookies that are necessary for the website to function properly, measure website performance and provide you with the best possible experience.

privacy.title: Cookie Consent
description: When you first visit our website, you will be asked to provide your consent for the use of cookies.
If you accept, your consent information will be stored for the purpose of managing your cookie preferences.
If you decline, a temporary cookie will be stored to remember your choice for a limited period.

privacy.title: Information We Store
privacy.description: When consent is accepted, we may store a unique identifier, the date and time of consent, and the consent version in our database.

privacy.title: Managing Cookies
privacy.description: You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. If the consent cookie is removed or expires, the consent notice may be displayed again.

privacy.title: Contact Us
privacy.description: If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us through our Contact Us page.
